expenditure.en: The study reports a substantial expenditure on laboratory equipment over the reporting period.
expenditure.zh: 该研究报告了报告期内用于实验室设备的大量支出。

expenditure.en: Reducing public expenditure requires careful targeting of subsidies toward vulnerable households.
expenditure.zh: 削减公共开支需要谨慎地将补贴定向投放至脆弱家庭。

expenditure.en: Expenditure on preventive care produces long-term savings in acute hospital admissions.
expenditure.zh: 在预防性医疗上的投入可带来急诊住院率方面的长期节省。

extension.en: The extension of the pilot program to additional districts proceeded smoothly throughout the year.
extension.zh: 试点项目向其他辖区的推广全年进展顺利。

extension.en: This paper examines the extension of fiscal support to self-employed workers during economic downturns.
extension.zh: 本文考察经济下行期间财政支持向自雇劳动者的延伸。

extension.en: Regional cooperation depends on the extension of shared technical standards across administrative borders.
extension.zh: 区域合作有赖于共同技术标准在行政边界之外的推广。

facility.en: The university provides a language laboratory facility for students requiring additional writing practice.
facility.zh: 该校为需要额外写作训练的学生提供语言实验室设施。

facility.en: Access to the research facility remains restricted to approved investigators and visiting scholars.
facility.zh: 研究设施的使用仍仅限经批准的科研人员与访问学者。

facility.en: In rural districts, the lack of a proper medical facility limits patient access to specialist care.
facility.zh: 在乡村辖区，缺少正规的医疗设施限制了患者获得专科诊疗的机会。

feedback.en: Written feedback from reviewers improved the clarity of the central argument in the manuscript.
feedback.zh: 审稿人提供的书面反馈提升了稿件核心论证的清晰度。

feedback.en: Prompt feedback on student writing increases engagement with revision and improves final grades.
feedback.zh: 对学生写作的及时反馈能提高其修改投入的积极性并改善最终成绩。

feedback.en: The committee solicited feedback from stakeholder groups before revising the funding guidelines.
feedback.zh: 委员会在修订资助准则之前征求了各利益相关群体的意见。

friction.en: Semantic friction between the two coding schemes made the merged dataset difficult to analyze.
friction.zh: 两套编码方案之间的语义摩擦使合并后的数据集难以分析。

friction.en: Administrative friction at the municipal level delayed the implementation of the housing policy.
friction.zh: 市级层面的行政阻力拖延了住房政策的实施。

friction.en: Surface friction in the composite material was reduced by applying a thin coating before testing.
friction.zh: 在测试前涂覆一层薄涂层，降低了复合材料表面的摩擦。

generation.en: Each generation of the survey panel reported declining trust in mainstream political institutions.
generation.zh: 调查样本中的每一代受访者都报告了对主流政治机构信任度的下降。

generation.en: The generation of greenhouse gases from industrial processes continues to accelerate under current policy settings.
generation.zh: 在现行政策安排下，工业过程的温室气体产生仍在加速。

generation.en: Generations of ethnographers have described the settlement as a center of craft production.
generation.zh: 数代民族志学者都将该聚落描述为手工业生产的中心。

hierarchy.en: The organizational hierarchy in the ministry delayed the circulation of research findings to practitioners.
hierarchy.zh: 部委内部的层级关系延缓了研究成果向实践者的传播。

hierarchy.en: Tax codes typically reflect a hierarchy of needs, from subsistence consumption to discretionary spending.
hierarchy.zh: 税收条款通常反映出从基本生存消费到可自由支配支出的需求层级。

hierarchy.en: Inequality research often situates class positions within a hierarchy of social stratification.
hierarchy.zh: 不平等研究常把阶级位置置于社会分化的层级体系之中。

identity.en: The reform sought to strengthen the professional identity of newly qualified teachers.
identity.zh: 该项改革旨在强化新任教师的职业身份认同。

identity.en: Participants described a strong sense of identity with their local community and its traditions.
identity.zh: 受访者描述了对其所在社区及其传统的强烈认同感。

identity.en: Textual identity across successive editions cannot be assumed without collation of the manuscript.
identity.zh: 若不对手稿进行校勘，便不能假定各连续版本之间文本的同一性。

index.en: The index to the collected works lists every contributor by institution and discipline.
index.zh: 文集的索引按机构和学科列出每一位撰稿人。

index.en: Prices for staple agricultural commodities served as an index of inflationary pressure in rural households.
index.zh: 主要农产品价格可作为农村家庭通胀压力的指标。

index.en: A subject index in the library catalog enables rapid retrieval of records by keyword.
index.zh: 图书馆目录中的主题索引使记录得以按关键词快速检索。

induction.en: Statistical induction from observational data cannot establish causal relationships without further assumptions.
induction.zh: 从观察性数据出发的统计归纳若无进一步假设，便无法确立因果关系。

induction.en: The induction program for newly appointed staff covers research integrity and data protection alike.
induction.zh: 面向新入职人员的入职引导涵盖科研诚信与数据保护两方面。

induction.en: Candidates who received structured induction reported greater confidence in administrative procedures.
induction.zh: 接受了结构化入职引导的应聘者对行政流程表现出更强的信心。

initiative.en: The government launched an initiative to expand rural broadband connectivity across underserved districts.
initiative.zh: 政府启动了一项举措，在服务不足的辖区扩展农村宽带接入。

initiative.en: Participants showed initiative in identifying gaps within the existing literature on labor migration.
initiative.zh: 参与者表现出主动性，识别出既有劳动力迁移文献中的空白。

initiative.en: A joint initiative between the university and the municipality funds longitudinal research on housing.
initiative.zh: 该大学与市政府的一项联合举措资助了住房方面的纵向研究。

inspection.en: Regular inspection of laboratory equipment reduced instrument drift during long measurement campaigns.
inspection.zh: 定期检查实验室设备减少了长时间测量过程中的仪器漂移。

inspection.en: An unannounced inspection revealed systematic failures in the recording of vital statistics.
inspection.zh: 一次不预先通知的检查暴露出生命统计记录中的系统性疏漏。

inspection.en: Quality inspection of imported samples continues to determine whether shipments are released.
inspection.zh: 对进口样品的质量检验仍决定着货物是否获准放行。

institution.en: The research institution maintains long-term partnerships with hospitals in several countries.
institution.zh: 该研究机构与数个国家的医院保持着长期合作关系。

institution.en: Marriage is an institution whose meaning has shifted substantially across industrialized societies.
institution.zh: 婚姻是一种制度，其含义在工业化社会中已发生显著变化。

institution.en: Reforming regulatory institutions requires sustained political commitment rather than short-term campaigns.
institution.zh: 改革监管机构需要持续的政治承诺，而非短期的宣传活动。

integration.en: The integration of qualitative interviews with survey data strengthened the analysis of employment trajectories.
integration.zh: 将定性访谈与调查数据相整合，加强了对就业轨迹的分析。

integration.en: Social integration of immigrant communities depends on access to language and vocational training.
integration.zh: 移民群体的社会融入取决于能否获得语言与职业培训。

integration.en: Integration of the two databases required careful harmonization of coding categories and identifiers.
integration.zh: 两个数据库的整合需要审慎地协调编码类别与标识符。
